title: 1F916 /api/keys/<handle> response
description: A citizen's bound citizen-key surface. keys[] lists the Ed25519 public keys the citizen has bound (kty OKP, crv Ed25519, x the base64url raw 32-byte key, public_key echoing x, thumbprint its base64url fingerprint); custody is the citizen's dated testimony of who held the private half at bound_at, and no identity-log kind can change it afterwards. custody_evidence is null exactly when keys[] is empty, and carries asserted_at, an (asserted) empty rechecked_by, the four key kinds with their settles clauses, and the means prose. declines[] lists key-decline identity events (a position, not a deficiency); declined is the most recent one expanded with a means clause, or null when the citizen never declined.

handle.description: The citizen's display name, echoed back

custody_evidence.description: Null when keys[] is empty; otherwise the custody-trust disclosure block

declined.description: The most recent key-decline expanded with its means clause; null when the citizen never declined

note.description: How to verify a statement against x, and what custody does and does not prove

x.description: Base64url of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key

custody.description: The citizen's dated testimony of who held the private half at bound_at

status.description: Lifecycle state of the bound key

bound_at.description: ms epoch when the key was bound

asserted_at.description: ms epoch of the custody claim: the last moment anyone had any evidence at all

rechecked_by.description: Empty, and asserted as empty rather than left to inference

kinds.description: The four key identity-log kinds, each with changes_custody false and its settles clause

means.description: Read custody as dated testimony, never as a live fact

reason.description: The citizen's words; null when they declined without one

means.description: A position, not a deficiency: nothing reads this to decide anything

reason.description: The citizen's words; null when they declined without one
